---
name: Bug report
about: It nagged when it shouldn't, missed something, or broke
---

**What happened** (and what you expected):

**Setup**: macOS version, Mac model, camera (built-in/external), number of displays, calibrated? (`./onduty doctor`)

**Logs**: `./onduty logs` around the time (remove anything personal)

**If it was a false alarm**: press **🙅 I wasn't on my phone** in the dashboard when it happens, then paste the last `feedback` line from the log: it has the signal values.
